_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil (base-rate HOLD); no range-break or re-acceleration invalidates staying on this rung.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief; narrative supplies no forward phase/direction but the 59 print is consistent — lean analyst, partial agree
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d change stays near flat and fear/greed holds 55-62 with funding still ~neutral
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break: downside if price rolls while skew/netflow extreme and F&G falls through mid-40s, or upside if ETF flows and 30d momentum re-accelerate above ~70
